extDescription.message: Browser extension for Bahamut Anime Crazy (ani.gamer.com.tw): provides a Cookie string for pasting into cookie.txt used by aniGamerPlus and similar apps. Prefer signing in from an Incognito window with “stay signed in.”

noCookies.message: No cookie found. Log in on Anime Crazy with “stay logged on”, refresh, or fetch a dedicated cookie in private browsing.

toastCopied.message: Copied. Paste into cookie.txt beside your app.

underButtonHint.message: We recommend signing in again in Incognito mode, then exporting your Cookie.
